name: Filler Word Detection and Classification Dataset
description: Dataset and benchmark for detecting and classifying filler words (e.g., 'um', 'uh') in speech recordings.
reputation: Published at Interspeech 2022 and moderately used by speech and disfluency-detection researchers.
notes: Relatively specialized / small-scale speech dataset; potential speaker and domain biases; not targeted at LLMs (audio-focused).
